Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-rays (Figures 1a and 1b) show two distinct nodular opacities indicated by arrows: one in the right middle lobe obscuring the right heart border and another retrocardiac nodule on the left. This specific finding, combined with a long history of dry cough in a middle-aged female former smoker, is characteristic of Diffuse Idiopathic Pulmonary Neuroendocrine Cell Hyperplasia (DIPNECH), which often presents with pulmonary nodules (tumorlets/carcinoids) and mosaic attenuation due to constrictive bronchiolitis.
